Ashford watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 2,250 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it.

The Bloodied watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
🕯️ Chen Feng is dead — contest. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Chen kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
The village's quarrel was with Chen — and Chen is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Jessica, Baraka, Yuki and 3 more speak for Nia — "Chen trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
Boiled 1L. Bacteria dead. (-35 kcal, 32 ticks tending the fire.)
That night, they bring Chen home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
🌾 Haven sends 1,600 kcal of grain to The Bloodied's fire — not tribute, the other way around. Someone's grandmother over there will remember who fed her. (Trust +8.)
🌾 Tribute wagons from The Bloodied turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)

🌙 Raid — Emberhold came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~800 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
Boiled 1L. Bacteria dead. (-35 kcal, 32 ticks tending the fire.)
Riders from The Bloodied: something's at THEIR door now. They can't spare anyone — and they wanted Haven to know first.
Word with the traders: The Bloodied door is clear again. Whatever had them, let go.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. A Elder veteran.
Grave robber: its bone knife is on the body. The dead don't need it — but you'll have to take it.
Seven days of silence, and the silence answered for Haven. The Bloodied's new speaker reads it plainly. (Trust -6.)

◈ THE WAR PATH — A moment of respect, from something that rarely respects. THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced Ugly-Eyes and lived to sit here. They faced The Loud Beast and lived to sit here. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).

Humanity walks — poorer, whole, free. The cameras follow for years: the long shot of small figures leaving the light, carrying their food and their dead and their songs. The highest-rated footage in galactic history. Nobody owns it. The prices are paid. The door stays ajar. Baraka walks with the relay now — the price, named and paid.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Chen speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Ibrahim.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 5 people, 35 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the northeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The northeast ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
📖 Codex: Standing Ovation — hits everything close around it. You won't forget this.
📖 Codex: Encore — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the northeast ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
🧳 Word of Haven’s answered calls, trade is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Ashford. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
A mother from The Red Table pressed a carved token into your hand: "for the winter you fed us." You didn't know there was a winter you'd fed.

📖 Codex: Sweeps Pounce — gives no warning — it just moves and hits. You won't forget this.
📖 Codex: Fast Forward — strikes without warning when you get close. You won't forget this.
🧳 Word from The Red Table: Priya is dead, and Victor and Rosa both claim the fire. The Red Table is choosing — or fighting.
👂 Overheard — Giulia (to Yuki): "Nia's story has a fresh coat of paint." Giulia taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Winnipeg, Canada. Just don't scrape it in front of them."

The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/12/6), with 2 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
◈ ABILITY — Empty Hands: You came with nothing to take. The table respects it. Dignity starts at 1.

◈ THE DEFIANT — You came to the table to tell it no. The System keeps recalculating, the way it does when it's afraid. Humanity walks. But walking has a price list — and the table just slid it across the light.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
